# The programs the root helper runs as root, by the path each deploy tool
# gives it for privilege mode split with every runtime on: tool, setting,
# path. Each tool's test holds what it renders to its lines here
# (internal/rootd config_test.go and install_split_env_test.go,
# pkg/daemon chart_split_test.go, integration-tests/safety
# terraform_privilege_mode_test.go and ansible_privilege_mode_test.go), and
# TestRootProgramsOnThisHostsLayout runs the helper's own check
# (checkRootBinaryFile) on each path on a real host: on the CI runner, and
# by scripts/rootd-program-layouts.sh in Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04, Debian 13
# and Amazon Linux 2023. "helper" is the helper's own defaults.
helper SB_ISOLATE_WORKERD_PATH /usr/local/bin/workerd
helper SB_JAILER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/jailer
helper SB_FIRECRACKER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/firecracker
helper SB_FIRECRACKER_MKFS_BIN /usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4
helper SB_ROOTD_RUNSC /usr/local/bin/runsc
install.sh SB_ISOLATE_WORKERD_PATH /usr/local/bin/workerd
install.sh SB_JAILER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/jailer
install.sh SB_FIRECRACKER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/firecracker
install.sh SB_FIRECRACKER_MKFS_BIN /usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4
chart SB_ISOLATE_WORKERD_PATH /opt/aerolvm-workerd/workerd
chart SB_ROOTD_RUNSC /usr/local/bin/runsc
terraform SB_JAILER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/jailer
terraform SB_FIRECRACKER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/firecracker
terraform SB_FIRECRACKER_MKFS_BIN /usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4
ansible SB_FIRECRACKER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/firecracker
ansible SB_JAILER_BINARY /usr/local/bin/jailer
